verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants query Pulumi Cloud stacks/resources and generate infrastructure code, and explicitly lists compatibility with Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, and Claude Desktop. This is first-party documentation with a dedicated docs page and probe confirmation, though independent hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server specifically is absent. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the MCP server itself.
